stills.description: A scientific graphic which represents a tipping cascade simulated in some modelling experiments. The four simulated elements - Greenland Ice Sheet, West Antarctica Ice Sheet, Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation and the Amazon Rainforest have differing chances of being involved in a cascade, or even initiating one.

stills.description: The North Atlantic climate of the Last Interglacial was affected by the weakening of the Atlantic meridional overturning circulation which had occurred at the time, in terms of sea surface temperature and precipitation .

stills.author: René M. van Westen, Michael Kliphuis, Henk A. Dijkstra
stills.description: This graphic shows how the collapse of the Atlantic meridional overturning circulation would occur under the model scenario investigated in the study.

stills.description: 2017 modelling which shows the 21st century warming trend under Representative Concentration Pathway 4.5 scenario, and how it will be affected by the collapse of the North Atlantic subpolar gyre, or by the collapse of the entire Atlantic Meriditional Overturning Circulation. Neither the image nor the original study makes reference to the baseline temperature against which the changes are plotted.
